ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M2-2,
Light Industry District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 28-G in the area
bound by:

The public alley next East of and parallel to South Ashland Avenue; a line 216 feet north
of and parallel to West 119" Street; South Ashland Avenue; West 119" Street; a line
99.9 feet east of and parallel to South Ashland Avenue; the public alley next North of
and parallel to West 119" Street

to those of a B1-1, Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

“R— EL.

Ronitie Mosley
Alderman, 21% Ward

Common Address:
11855 S. Ashland Avenue
1552 W. 119" Street
